title: Quant onboarding manifest & regression orchestration for mixed-precision variants
creator: Ariana Patel
description:
Scope: Create a reproducible, auditable onboarding "manifest" and orchestration flow for publishing quantization profiles (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) to the model catalog, including deterministic version pinning and automated regression detection. Goal is to enable safe promotion of low-precision variants into Dedicated and Hosted deployments with measurable SLOs and a fast rollback path.

Deliverables: a profile manifest schema, CI gating steps, telemetry contract and thresholds, canary wave generator, automated pin/publish tooling, and a docs/playbook for solutions engineers and partners. Exclusions: model conversion toolchains (assume artifact produced by model team), and KMS integrations (handled by infra).

Key outcomes: reproducible artifact lineage (profile -> model version), standardized perf/quality deltas for publishing decisions, automated rollback triggers, and a visible audit trail in Console and the catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest schema published and accepted by model-onboard reviewers
CI pipeline enforces smoke performance checks for every quant profile upload
Canary orchestration can run N sequential waves with configurable sample sizes
Automated regression detector raises a blocking alert if perf/quality delta exceeds thresholds
Published profile exposes immutable pin token that consumers can reference
Rollback workflow documented and validated end-to-end in a staging environment
steps: Define profile manifest fields (model_id, base_model_sha, quant_type, hyperparams, kernel_hint, memory_estimate, expected_throughput, sample_prompt_set reference)
Implement manifest validator and CLI uploader (python tool) that returns deterministic artifact hash
Integrate uploader with CI to store profile artifact in artifact registry with metadata
Create a canary-wave service that coordinates traffic routing to profile variants for staged evaluation
Wire telemetry ingestion to the regression detector with contract metrics and SLOs
Publish profile to catalog with pin token and visibility in Console; add 'certified' badge on pass
canary_strategy: Wave 0: dry-run smoke against synthetic latency-sensitive prompts (no customer traffic)
Wave 1: 1% sampled customer traffic or synthetic-from-prod traces for 24h
Wave 2: 10% routed, 72h monitoring with extended tail latency histograms
Wave 3: 50% ramp, validate cost/perf ratio and failure modes
Promotion: automatic when all waves pass thresholds, otherwise hold and notify owners
Rollback trigger: any wave where quality score delta > 2% absolute or latency P95 regression > 30% vs baseline
telemetry_contract: Required metrics: token_throughput, tokens_per_second, latency_p50/p90/p95/p99, error_rate, output_quality_score
Quality checks: BLEU/EM/semantic-similarity on canonical prompts and a customer-themed eval suite
SLO thresholds: p95 latency increase <= 20% AND quality delta <= 1% for promotion
Telemetry tags: profile_id, quant_type, kernel_variant, region, instance_type
Ingest cadence: 1min aggregates and 1s streaming for tail sampling
publishing_flow: Uploader produces artifact and manifest, signs with CI bot key, stores in registry (artifact://profiles/<profile_hash>)
Registry entry contains metadata, baseline performance profile, and canonical prompt set reference
Catalog UI shows available profiles per model with pin token (profile:<profile_hash>) and recommended rollout policy
Pin semantics: a profile pin locks model->profile mapping for a deployment until explicitly updated via a release flow
Publish action triggers an optional automated canary if 'auto_canary: true' in manifest
rollback_playbook: Automatic immediate rollback: routing switch to last-known-good pinned profile when detector fires
Manual rollback: console action that demotes profile and records reason; triggers incident runbook
Post-incident: create regression ticket with perf diffs and attach waveform dumps and sample failure prompts
Promote alternate: if multiple pinned candidates exist, auto-evaluate secondary candidate before full rollback
notes: Trade-offs: stricter thresholds reduce false-positive promotions but slow rollouts; propose adaptive thresholding based on model maturity
Need to coordinate with model-onboard team for canonical prompt sets — request B2B prompt bank export format
Consider storing lightweight kernel hints to guide runtime selection for best perf on specific hardware
FP8/GPTQ/AWQ cover different error modes; acceptance checks should include both statistical and worst-case adversarial prompts
We should avoid coupling pin tokens to tenant-specific deployment ids to keep pins portable across Dedicated and Hosted
